assertions: Only same-platform, same-source observations enter a comparison; no cross-platform score is produced.
A delta requires the same native metric definition, surface, scope, unit, duration and complete finalized windows.
Suppressed and unavailable values remain unknown; not-finalized values remain pending and are never coerced to zero.
Platform-attributed requires an exact PublicationReceipt and evidence; temporal association explicitly denies causality; missing attribution remains unknown.
The capability reads no platform account, writes no knowledge, executes no action and grants no authority.
